name: Pope Shenouda III of Alexandria
role: Head of the Coptic Church from 1971 to 2012
contribution: The 117th Pope of Alexandria and Patriarch of the See of St. Mark.

checks.lead: Pope Shenouda III (born Nazir Gayed Roufail; 3 August 1923 – 17 March 2012) was the 117th Pope of Alexandria and Patriarch of the See of St. Mark. His papacy lasted 40 years, 4 months, and 4 days, from 14 November 1971 until his death in 2012.
